decisions.reason: Moving the battery connector to the back opposite USB-C does not change the power board's existing USB-C position, mounting-hole, size, aspect-ratio, base-integration, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source changes only the battery connector's placement and does not alter component sourceability, cost tolerance, compatibility, or availability requirements.
Battery connector placement is unrelated to the I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
